name: tracker
title: Tracker
description: A row of status blocks, one per day or check, for uptime or completion.

when: Status over a run of days or checks.

instead.when: Each day has an amount, not a status.
Only the overall share done matters.

builtIn: A "Show as table" button shows the same data as a table, which screen readers get by default.
youProvide: A title that says what the figure is.
